title: 30. GCS Capability System
summary: Describes the protocol-neutral capability system that discovers, governs, routes, and executes external and local operations within GeniusCognitiveSystem, normalizing operations into canonical contracts before execution.
notes: Architectural design documentation with representative schemas and aspirational implementation requirements. No finalized decisions (ADR), no user stories/acceptance criteria (PRD), and no finalized API contracts (SPEC). Schemas presented are described as representative/proposed, not locked technical specifications.
